basic_info.description: Bayview Gem!!! Newly built in 2003, this 5-bedroom and 4-bath beautiful home features high ceilings, hard wood floors and exceptional natural light throughout. The upper level has 2BD/2BA plus a bonus room for office or kids playroom. Lower level has 3BD/2BA, plus a family room. Separate entrance ensures the convenience and privacy for all occupant. Great for multi generation or extra rental income!!! Easy access to freeway, public transportation, close to schools, shops, restaurants and parks. Must see!!!
